FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

South Dakota fishing licence

Anglers aged 18 or older need a fishing licence. A visitor's three-day licence also needs a Habitat Stamp, while the one-day licence does not.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 18 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 18 can fish and keep their own limit without a licence.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-daynon residentSelected calendar day$26 USD
Non-resident 3-daynon resident3 consecutive calendar days$45 USD
Non-resident annualnon residentDecember 15, 2025–January 31, 2027$80 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident Habitat Stamp · $25 USD
    Required once per licence year from age 18 with most licences; one-day fishing licences are exempt.

Rules visitors should know

  • The one-day licence ends at midnight.
  • Licences cannot be transferred or refunded.
  • The listed prices exclude agent fees.

How to buy

Use the GFP online licence service, retail stores, bait shops, or participating county treasurers.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in South Dakota?

Anglers aged 18 or older need a fishing licence. A visitor's three-day licence also needs a Habitat Stamp, while the one-day licence does not.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in South Dakota?

Non-resident 1-day: $26 USD; Non-resident 3-day: $45 USD; Non-resident annual: $80 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in South Dakota?

Use the GFP online licence service, retail stores, bait shops, or participating county treasurers.
